title: Moving off a deactivated term: how the note names the old term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 60 days after the invoice date, is deactivated and held only by customer {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-35 N60 and {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-35 Solo.
  • Your user name is {User-A}.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-35 Admin.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  5. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  6. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  7. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Term-A} is listed.
  • Step 2: the menu opens.
  • Step 3: the window "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens with {Customer-A} ticked.
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 30.
  • Step 5: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows.
  • Step 6: the page opens.
  • Step 7: the note reads "Credit term changed from {Term-A} to Net 30 by {User-A} (Move Customers)." — or with "{Term-A} (Inactive)", as the PO answers (see the note).

The PRD does not say whether a deactivated term is named plainly or with "(Inactive)" in the note and the log. Question 5 on Chris Ward's sheet (not sent yet) asks; this case is held until he answers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R11: “Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, authored by the user who moved it, reading "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." A customer moved from a blank term reads "from COD".”
  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
